description: Visningstjänst för järnvägsdata - BanInfo is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo-baninfo.trafikverket.se. A viewing service containing a selection of the Swedish Transport Administration's Rail Data. The service is used by NJDB on the web, Stigfinnaren and JaK. This is a service that contains open data and is published externally. To access the service, paste the access address link into the appropriate software (e.g. ArcGIS). Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Rail data display service - BanInfo" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include visningstjänst, view service. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-05-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
